title: Assignment rule "Online status" did not skip a member with no session

panels.caption: With Online status required, the member with no session still got the lead
Zoho: only users logged in on the web count as online
text: Zoho CRM, Setting up Assignment Rules: availability is checked on online status (logged in to CRM) and/or shift timing; a user who is not logged in is unavailable and the default user gets the record.
"An online user is one that is online on web. There will be maximum of 5 mins delay in fetching online users status."
panels.flag: ZOHO DOCS — not seen on screen

rows.b: Online status on, first member not signed in

notes: Likely cause NDC-2418: Login History keeps sessions Active after they expire (255 active, back to 30 Aug), and the test itself signed test user 2 in through the API, so every member looks online.
Re-run with a member that has no session at all after NDC-2418 and NDC-2419 (assignment sets no owner since 22 Oct) are fixed.
